comments.note: The notFound() helper used by assertSafeSlug() returns NOT_FOUND (→ HTTP 404), but the WP spec says HTTP 400 for unsafe slugs. This is consistent with all other handlers in api.ts (handleGetPlanDocument, handleGetSynthesisDocument, etc.) which also produce 404 for slug errors. The discrepancy is pre-existing and out of scope, but worth noting for future spec alignment.

In handleGetRunMetadata, the catch block swallows both ENOENT (file not found) and JSON.parse errors equally, producing NOT_FOUND in both cases. If a malformed .orchestrator-run.json were ever written, the caller would get an opaque 404 rather than a 500. Low risk given the sidecar is machine-written, but a typed catch could produce a more helpful error for the malformed-JSON case.

api.ts uses a trailing-spaces alignment style in function parameter lists (e.g. logsDir: string, statusFilename: string with extra spaces for visual alignment). The new handleGetRunMetadata() follows the standard single-space style matching the majority of other handlers. No change needed, but the inconsistency pre-exists in the file.

comments.note: Info — No runtime schema validation on returned .orchestrator-run.json content. OWASP A04 (Insecure Design / defence-in-depth). File: mcp-server/gui/api.ts, line 1742 (JSON.parse(raw) return). The handler proxies the raw parsed JSON to the client without a Zod schema check. For the current local-only tool context this is acceptable — the file is written exclusively by the orchestrator itself. Recommendation: as the sidecar format stabilises, add a Zod schema to validate the returned structure and make the contract explicit.

Info — All OWASP Top 10 categories reviewed. No Critical or High issues identified. Slug path-traversal guard (assertSafeSlug → SAFE_SLUG_REGEX) is correctly applied before any file access. AMBIGUOUS→NOT_FOUND downgrade in resolveProjectStore prevents cross-namespace existence leaks. File path is constructed as join(planPath, '.orchestrator-run.json') where '.orchestrator-run.json' is hardcoded — even a tampered planPath in .meta.json cannot inject additional path segments. JSON.parse result is returned as unknown with no eval or further interpretation. Test suite covers slug-with-slash, double-dot traversal, and empty-slug rejection.
